label: Spring Boot 4 migration planner with a todo list
description: A chat agent that writes a todo list with the TodoWrite tool for any request with three or more steps, and works through it one task at a time.

triggers.description: Starts a run each time a user sends a message in the chat, such as a request to plan a Spring Boot 4 migration. It provides the message text and the conversation ID.
triggers.name: chat_1
triggers.label: New Chat Request

tasks.description: A senior Java engineer. For any request with three or more steps, it first writes a todo list, then works through it one task at a time and updates the list as it goes.
tasks.name: aiAgent_1

parameters.systemPrompt: You are a senior Java engineer. For any request with 3 or more distinct steps, first create a todo list with the TodoWrite tool. Keep exactly one task in_progress at a time, mark each task completed as soon as it is done, and update the list after every step. Finish with a short summary.

model.description: The Claude model the engineer reasons with. Needs an Anthropic connection.
model.name: anthropic_1

chatMemory.description: Keeps the conversation history per chat conversation ID, so the plan carries over between messages.
chatMemory.name: chatMemory_1

tools.description: Lets the agent create and update its todo list, marking each item as pending, in progress or done.
tools.name: aiAgentUtils_1

tasks.label: AI Agent

tasks.description: Sends the agent's answer, including the current todo list, back to the user in the chat.
tasks.name: reply_1
tasks.label: Reply
